summary: Hike-in L-4 lookout in Idaho's Clearwater National Forest, built in 1951 to replace earlier 1935 and 1922 structures and still staffed each summer.

facts.design: L-4 cab with catwalk on a 53-foot treated timber tower

access.note: Described as hike-in; no road access or rental mentioned.

events.note: Original log cabin with crow's-nest built on the site; reportedly still present
45-foot pole tower with L-6 cab erected, replacing/supplementing the 1922 cabin
Bud Moore and Owen Johnson staffed the lookout 1935-1938
Current 53-foot L-4 timber tower built, replacing the 1935 pole tower
Added to the National Historic Lookout Register April 24, 2009

evidence.supports: L-4 cab with catwalk, 53-foot timber tower built 1951, replaced 1935 pole tower and 1922 log cabin still on site
evidence.quote: A classic example of the L-4 cab with catwalk, Bear Mountain Lookout is on 53’ timber tower built in 1951. It replaced an L-6 cab on a 45’ pole tower dating to 1935 and the 1922 Clearwater National Forest log cabin which is still there.

evidence.supports: 1922 log cabin, 1935 pole tower, present 1951 L-4 staffed every summer
evidence.quote: Developed in 1922 with a log cabin and crow's nest, a 45' L-6 tower was built in 1935. The present 53' treated timber L-4, built in 1951, is staffed every summer.

evidence.supports: Hike-in, staffed, elevation and build history timeline
1935 pole tower and 1951 timber tower dates, NHLR registration
evidence.quote: 1935 – 45′ Pole L-6 Tower 1951 – 53′ Treated Timber L-4 2009 – Added to the National Historic Lookout Register
1924 1935–1938 Bud Moore (Fire Lookouts of the Northwest) Owen Johnson (Fire Lookouts of the Northwest) 1982–1983 Steve Kalling

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Brief's build year noted as having conflicting sources elsewhere; all three sources read here agree the current structure dates to 1951, replacing a 1935 pole tower and a 1922 log cabin, so no conflict appeared across these sources.

notes_for_editor: Staffing record has gaps between 1938 and 1982 and after 1983; no source gives a complete history or states whether rental is offered. Brief flagged a built-year conflict across sources generally, but the three pages read here were consistent on 1951 for the current tower.
